# LORAN LAB

> Interactive Loran-C & eLoran Terrestrial Hyperbolic Radionavigation Simulator

LORAN LAB is a scientific research and educational web application designed for exploring 100 kHz pulsed radio navigation systems, hyperbolic time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) position fixes, geometric dilution of precision (GDOP), and Additional Secondary Factor (ASF) propagation delays.

## Core Modules
- [eLoran Simulator](https://eloran.vercel.app/eloran): All-in-view pseudorange solver, ASF corrections, and H-field pulse tracking.
- [Loran-C Simulator](https://eloran.vercel.app/loran-c): Classical hyperbolic lines of position (LOPs), master/secondary chains, and GDOP contour mapping.
- [RF Waveforms & Pulse Viewer](https://eloran.vercel.app/waveforms): 100 kHz pulse synthesis, envelope-to-cycle difference (ECD), and phase codes.
- [Theory & Documentation](https://eloran.vercel.app/learn): Mathematical foundations of Loran-C and modern eLoran.
- [Technical Specifications & Provenance](https://eloran.vercel.app/about): Mathematical constants, ITU-R models, and academic citations.
